sources.title: 12 U.S.C. § 5220, statutory note 'Effect of Foreclosure on Preexisting Tenancy' (Protecting Tenants at Foreclosure Act § 702) — United States Code, 2024 Edition
sources.authorityNotes: TIER 1 — U.S. Government Publishing Office edition of the United States Code, raw HTML cached. The Protecting Tenants at Foreclosure Act is not a numbered Code section; its tenant-protection section (Pub. L. 111-22, div. A, title VII, § 702, as amended) is printed as a statutory note under 12 U.S.C. 5220, followed by bracketed notes recording the repeal of the 2014 sunset and the restoration by Pub. L. 115-174 § 304. The 2023 Edition page was also fetched and carries the same note. Section 703 (Section 8 voucher tenancies) is set out elsewhere and was not read.
sources.stalenessRisk: LOW — federal statute; changes only by Act of Congress. This is the 2024 Edition; re-check the newest edition on govinfo.gov before each refresh.

sources.title: CA 18-4: Restoration of the Protecting Tenants at Foreclosure Act — Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
sources.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
sources.authorityNotes: TIER 1 — Federal Reserve Board Consumer Affairs letter dated June 22, 2018, raw HTML cached. An agency's supervisory description of the law, addressed to examiners; the letter itself says no federal agency has authority to interpret the law. Used for the effective date, the absence of an expiration date, and the plain-language list of who is not covered.
sources.stalenessRisk: LOW — a dated letter that will not change; it would be superseded rather than edited. Check the page for a 'superseded by' line before each refresh.
